character: A mid-sized ski area at the top of Big Cottonwood Canyon, next to Solitude, with a strong local and snowboard following, terrain parks and lift-served night skiing on part of the mountain.
learning: Reference note: beginner terrain sits near the base, served by the Explorer lift, and the resort runs a ski and snowboard school. Confirm current learning lifts, carpets and lesson products.

source.note: Search summary: 2025-26 opening Dec. 2, 2025 (Ski Utah 2025-26 opening-dates list; may show dates revised after weather delays). Closing date was still "TBD" in the closing-date roundup summary.

season.notes: No official 2026-27 opening date was found as of 2026-09-30. Utah roundups (OnTheSnow projected openings, Salt Lake Tribune 20 Sep 2026) list a projected Dec. 4, 2026, explicitly not yet announced, so it is not stored as an announced date. 2025-26 opened Dec. 2, 2025 (see history).

prices.note: Weekday adult $149 (two-day $295). The season is not stated (the summary labelled it 2026-27 only because the query asked) — may be the 2025-26 listing. Confirm on brightonresort.com.
